The invitation-accept flow emits `member.joined` in `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts:153`. `organization-service.ts:47` emits it too, but that is the emit side.

Two files register a handler for `member.joined`, and both are listed below with the repositories they import. `activity-service.ts` and `webhook-service.ts` do not subscribe to it: activity only covers `member.invited` and `member.role_changed`, and webhooks cover four other events.

- **`src/server/services/usage-service.ts`** registers the handler in `registerUsageListeners`, which bumps `seatsUsed`. It imports `organization-repository` and `usage-repository`.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** registers the handler in `registerFanOut`, which runs when the module loads. It notifies the org owner. It imports `issue-repository`, `notification-repository`, `organization-repository` and `notification-preference-repository`.

`organization-repository` is imported by both files, so the union is five distinct files.

ANSWER: src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts
